issues.t: Battery pack may let water in (recall)
issues.sym: A high-voltage battery warning, a no-start, or a sudden loss of drive power, often after rain, washing or water crossings.
issues.why: On some early pickups the high-voltage battery enclosure was not sealed properly, so water can get inside. GM recalled 2022-2023 Hummer EV pickups.
issues.next: Run your VIN for open recalls and keep the truck out of deep water until the repair is done. If drive power is lost, pull over safely and call for a tow.

issues.t: Battery pack connections may be welded wrong (recall)
issues.sym: Warning messages and a possible sudden loss of drive power.
issues.why: In a small number of 2022 trucks, connections inside the battery pack may be out of place or poorly welded. GM recalled them.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall. The dealer inspects the pack and replaces it free if needed.

issues.t: Battery module part may be loose inside pack (recall)
issues.sym: There may be no warning before a problem; the risk is a battery fault.
issues.why: A 2026 recall covers a handful of 2022 pickups whose high-voltage battery may have an internal module component that was not properly secured.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. The fix is a free battery replacement.

issues.t: Battery or motor control software sets warning codes
issues.sym: A warning light or service message with a stored fault code, sometimes with nothing else wrong.
issues.why: A software error in the battery energy control module and drive motor control module can set false trouble codes. GM issued a service update to reprogram both modules.
issues.next: Ask a GM EV-certified dealer to check for service update N232429880 and other software campaigns on your VIN.

issues.t: Glitches fixed by vehicle-wide software updates
issues.sym: Screen, radio or app glitches, features that act up, or a truck that does not receive over-the-air updates.
issues.why: GM has released several dealer software campaigns for 2022-2023 pickups that reprogram many modules, including the radio and battery controller, to fix bugs and prepare for future updates.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to check for open software campaigns (such as N242442070, N242436170 and N252502390). They take about one to two hours.

issues.t: Taillights stay off or stay on (recall)
issues.sym: A taillight that does not light or stays lit when it should not.
issues.why: Software in the taillights could leave a lamp dark or stuck on. GM replaced the taillight assemblies on the few affected trucks.
issues.next: Walk around the truck with the lights on and check the brake and tail lamps. Check your VIN for the recall.

issues.t: Heater blows cold and windows will not defrost
issues.sym: The heater blows only cold air now and then, often in winter, so the windows fog and will not clear.
issues.why: An owner was told a heater module needed replacing; the problem had come back every winter.
issues.next: Do not drive if you cannot clear the windshield. Have the dealer diagnose the cabin heater while the truck is under warranty.

issues.t: Roof panels leak water into the cabin
issues.sym: Water dripping from the removable roof panels or headliner, wet seats or carpet, and rust on interior metal or seat rails.
issues.why: The removable Infinity Roof panels and seals can let water in. One owner reported repeated failed repair attempts and rust inside the cab.
issues.next: Have the dealer water-test the roof seals and document every visit. Dry the interior quickly so wiring and airbag sensors are not damaged.

issues.t: Front seat belt buckle bolts may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no sign; a loose buckle may move more than normal.
issues.why: The bolts holding the front seat belt buckles may not have been tightened properly at the factory, so the belt may not hold you in a crash. GM recalled 2023-2024 pickups and 2024 SUVs.
issues.next: Check your VIN for this recall; the dealer tightens the bolts for free.

issues.t: Rear drive motor wiring can short (recall)
issues.sym: A sudden loss of drive power while driving.
issues.why: Wires inside the rear drive unit’s electric motor may not be insulated enough and can touch, shutting the motor down. GM recalled a small number of 2024 trucks and SUVs.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 24V320. The dealer replaces the rear drive unit for free, which takes about six hours.

issues.t: Will not charge, Service Engine Soon light
issues.sym: The truck will not charge and the Service Engine Soon light comes on, so you could get stranded with a low battery.
issues.why: An owner reported the problem returning after weeks at the dealer. The exact cause was not stated.
issues.next: Try a different charger to rule out the station, then have the dealer read the charging codes. Keep records of every visit.

issues.t: Rolls on a slope with one-pedal driving, Service ESC
issues.sym: While stopped on a grade with one-pedal driving on, the truck shakes and creeps forward even with the brake pressed, and a Service ESC message appears.
issues.why: An owner reported this along with being unable to accelerate until restarting. It points to a brake or stability control fault.
issues.next: Hold the truck with the brake and park it if this happens, then have the brake and stability systems checked right away.

issues.sym: The wipers keep running and washer fluid keeps spraying, blocking your view in rain.
issues.why: An owner reported a dealer could not fix it over two visits and was waiting for parts.
issues.next: Pull over if you cannot see clearly. Have the dealer check the wiper switch and controls.

issues.t: Sudden loss of drive power from rear motor failure
issues.sym: The truck loses power, and in one report power braking and steering assist too, forcing the driver to coast to a stop.
issues.why: An owner of a nearly new truck reported the rear motor failed and damaged the transaxle.
issues.next: If power is lost, steer to the shoulder and put on hazards. Have it towed to an EV-certified dealer.

issues.t: Driver assist and Super Cruise unavailable
issues.sym: Messages such as "Forward Collision Avoidance System Unavailable," or Super Cruise and side sensors not working when needed.
issues.why: Owners report the camera and radar-based driver-assist systems shutting off or not reacting. The cause was not identified.
issues.next: Clean the cameras and sensors, and do not rely on the systems while warnings are shown. Have the dealer check for sensor faults and software updates.

issues.t: Rear seat belt bracket loose (missing nut)
issues.sym: A rear seat belt that moves or rattles at its mounting point.
issues.why: On one SUV, the rear seat belt bracket came off the frame because its mounting nut was never installed at the factory.
issues.next: Pull on each seat belt anchor to check it is solid. Have a dealer fix any loose anchor before carrying passengers in that seat.

issues.t: Multiple warning lights come on at once
issues.sym: Several warning lights appear at once, whether parked, idling or driving.
issues.why: An owner reported the dealer called the system "extremely sensitive" but did not repair it.
issues.next: Note which warnings appear and take photos. Have the dealer scan all modules and check for software updates.
